name: adrio
description: Adrio is an AI media buyer for Meta ads. It creates static and video ad creatives for your brand, launches them to Facebook and Instagram through its ad launcher, and manages your media buying, with your approval on every change.

interface.shortDescription: AI media buyer for Meta ads
interface.longDescription:
Adrio is an AI media buyer for Meta ads. Connect your Adrio account and run your Facebook and Instagram advertising from ChatGPT.

Create ads: brief Spark, Adrio's creative agent, to make static and video ad creatives from your products, brand voice and winning angles.

Launch ads: send finished creatives to Meta through Adrio's ad launcher, with campaigns, ad sets and copy planned from what has worked for your account before.

Manage media buying: Spark watches performance and proposes what to scale, pause or test next.

Research competitors: search a library of analyzed competitor ads by angle, hook, format or company, and save the best ones to swipe-file boards.

Results open as interactive cards in the conversation. Nothing changes in your workspace or your Meta account, and no credits are spent, until you approve it.
defaultPrompt: Make four static Meta ads for my newest product
Find competitor ads that use a before-and-after hook
Plan a Meta launch for my best recent creatives
